name: Boku ga Kowashita Ojou-sama
source:
The girl is mine! She's my girl at last!! Humiliate the pretty girl Rinka in various locations in school! The ending scene may vary at your command choice! She might be pregnant after all!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE029733.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
那个女孩是我的！她终于是我的女人了！！在学校的不同地点羞辱美少女琳卡！结局场景可能会根据你的命令选择而有所不同！毕竟她可能怀孕了！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE029733.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
